official_sources: Badger survey or research licence A25

official_measurement_examples.name: Sett protection
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England guidance states badgers and their setts are protected by law and damaging, blocking or disturbing setts can be unlawful.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning standing advice
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England's badger standing advice is a material planning consideration when badgers may be affected by development.

official_measurement_examples.name: A24 development licence
official_measurement_examples.fact: A24 is the development-purpose route for interfering with badger setts and requires evidence of the underlying permission or consent with the application.

official_measurement_examples.name: A24 decision period
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England states it will decide an A24 licence application within 30 working days of receiving the application and supporting documents.

official_measurement_examples.name: CL35 seasonal restriction
official_measurement_examples.fact: CL35 can only be used to exclude badgers or destroy setts between 1 July and 30 November; outside that period an individual licence is needed for those purposes.

official_measurement_examples.name: Survey licence distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: A25 is a survey or research licence and is distinct from a development mitigation licence.

official_measurement_examples.name: Specialised class licences
official_measurement_examples.fact: CL26 and CL27 are limited to defined forestry or drainage users and operations and are not general development licences.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Badger licensing does not itself grant planning permission, determine sett absence or prove parcel development capacity.

core_rules: badger protection law is not proof a sett exists on a parcel
badger survey result is not planning permission
planning permission is not an A24 badger licence
A24 development licence is distinct from A25 survey licence
CL35 seasonal conditions must be preserved
CL26 forestry licence is not a general development licence
CL27 drainage licence is not a general development licence
standing advice is not a planning decision
sett presence is not automatic planning refusal
historic badger survey must retain its date and scope
licence applicant permission evidence is not the licence itself
badger sett protection does not determine land ownership
licensing does not reserve development capacity
badger compliance does not create access rights
no parcel badger clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
